title: Solid-oxide-cell production facility F1 versus F2 occupancy classification (Council Order 2024-06)

facts.text: A permit refusal concerned a proposed solid-oxide-cell manufacturing facility designed by the applicant as F2; Calgary considered it F1 because of chemical use/dispensing and process hazards.

The June 2024 review listed requested details including chemical classes, flashpoints, lower/upper explosive limits, inventories, processes, hydrogen use, building code analysis and registered professional schedules/drawings.
The appeal record included an architect and two professional engineers and the decision summarizes hazard/occupancy reports, room uses, fire separations and protection measures.

limitations: The appeal briefs, deficiency reports and underlying professional reports are not attached as separate files.
The order uses NBC(AE) 2019, not the current 2023 Alberta edition.
